properties.name: Lift Series

properties.description: Max airflow capacity (m³/h) for matching against required Ventilationsbehov.

properties.description: Material used for the truck body and cargo bed.

properties.description: Groups truck add-on products so configurator elements can sync them automatically.

properties.name: Weight (kg)
properties.description: Weight of the part in kg. Summed by the rule "Calculate Total Truck Weight".

properties.name: Max kilometres per year
properties.description: Most kilometres per year this engine is built for.

properties.name: Rear axles
properties.description: Number of rear axles a part is made for.

properties.name: Guided role
properties.description: Which step of the guided truck configurator this product belongs to.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: The kind of work this truck, bed, or add-on is built for.

properties.name: Terrain
properties.description: Surfaces this drivetrain or add-on is built for.

properties.name: Emission class
properties.description: Emission zone this engine is allowed in. None means no zone restriction.

properties.name: Max payload (kg)
properties.description: Highest payload this model, drivetrain, or bed may carry.

properties.name: Max driving hours per day
properties.description: Most hours per day a driver can work comfortably from this cab.

properties.name: Guide price (DKK)
properties.description: Denmark list price used to recommend the cheapest product that still fits. Not a second sales price.

properties.name: Guided truck
properties.description: Marks a product the guided truck configurator is allowed to hide or recommend. Keeps where-not filters inside this assortment.

properties.name: Requires charging
properties.description: True when the engine needs depot charging.

properties.name: STL Frame Band
properties.description: Maximum finished fabric width band (mm nominal)

properties.name: TQ Equipment Class
properties.description: size bands for filters and softeners
